note: Source of truth for the product cards on the home page. Run `npm run build:cards` after editing: it rewrites the card markup and the script data in public-site/index.html. Photos: /img/card-<key>-640.webp and /img/card-<key>-1200.webp (see public-site/img/CARD-IMAGES.md). A card with no photo yet shows its branded gradient.

cards.name: Shop POS
cards.desc: Retail, hardware, supermarkets. Inventory, barcodes, wholesale pricing, multi-branch.
cards.alt: Retail shop with stocked shelves, a touchscreen POS terminal and a barcode scanner at the checkout counter

cards.name: Hotel / Restaurant / Bar
cards.desc: Tables, rooms, takeaway orders, kitchen tickets, dish recipes — one app for all three.
cards.alt: Restaurant dining table set with glasses and plates under warm evening lighting

cards.name: Hospital / HMIS
cards.desc: Patient records, consultations, one-page prescriptions, a ready laboratory list, inpatient beds, meals and a single admission account.
cards.alt: Doctor in a white coat holding a tablet in a clean hospital ward

cards.name: Production POS
cards.desc: Build finished goods from raw components, hire equipment out, track every batch.
cards.alt: Worker in a hard hat operating equipment on a manufacturing production line

cards.name: Pharmacy POS
cards.desc: Batch-level expiry tracking, FEFO stock rotation, prescription records.
cards.alt: Pharmacy counter with organised medicine shelves, a barcode scanner and a computer terminal

cards.name: Services (Repairs, Salons & Bookings)
cards.desc: Phone/electronics repair, salons & barbershops, garages, laundromats — client job tracking, staff bookings/appointments, and walk-in sales in one app.
cards.alt: Phone repair, salon scissors and a washing machine representing service businesses

cards.name: Water Refill Station (AquaPOS)
cards.desc: Dispenser and bale sales, tiered pricing, delivery zones, and refill tracking.
cards.alt: Clean refillable water bottles beside a commercial water dispenser at a refill station

cards.name: Car Wash & Cleaning
cards.desc: Car check-in by number plate, a live jobs board, carpets, sofas and house cleaning, 9 + 1 free loyalty, automatic SMS, staff accountability and job billing with M-Pesa.
cards.alt: A car being washed with foam and a pressure washer at a car wash bay
